Exchange/platform: Gate
Headline: Auto-Invest Championship: Share 20,000 USDT and Win a 5% APR Boost Voucher
Prize pool: 20K USDT
Start: 2026-11-28T08:00:00Z · End: 2027-01-23T08:00:00Z
Most one person can get (parsed): 500 USDT
OFFICIAL RULES TEXT:
To thank our users for their continued support, Gate is launching the Auto-Invest Championship. Compete for a share of the 20,000 USDT prize pool, complete the Auto-Invest challenge to unlock a USDT Earn APR Boost Voucher, and enjoy Auto-Invest trading fee rebates.
## Promotion Period: November 28, 2026, 08:00 – January 17, 2027, 08:00 (UTC)
## Promotion 1: Leaderboard Challenge — Share 20,000 USDT
Users with more than 500 USDT in cumulative Auto-Invest purchases during the promotion will be ranked by their total purchase amount. The top 100 eligible users will share the 20,000 USDT prize pool in proportion to their cumulative purchase amounts.
Individual Reward = Individual Cumulative Auto-Invest Purchase Amount ÷ Combined Cumulative Auto-Invest Purchase Amount of All Eligible Winners × 20,000 USDT.
## Promotion 2: Win a 5% APR Boost Voucher
Complete at least 7 successful Auto-Invest orders and accumulate more than 500 USDT in total Auto-Invest purchases during the promotion. The first 100 qualifying users will each receive one USDT Earn APR Boost Voucher.
Daily purchases and consecutive check-ins are not required. Both daily and weekly Auto-Invest schedules are eligible, with no promotion-specific minimum purchase amount per order.
## Promotion 3: Auto-Invest Trading Fee Rebates for All
Make Auto-Invest purchases using USDT during the promotion to receive a 100% rebate on eligible spot trading fees actually paid, capped at 500 USDT per user.
Rebates will be issued as Trading Fee Cashback Vouchers.
## Notes
- Users must register for the promotion and complete identity verification. Only one account per verified individual is eligible; subaccounts cannot participate independently.
- Purchase amounts and order counts are based on successfully executed Auto-Invest orders during the promotion. Creating a plan, unexecuted orders, failed orders and cancelled orders do not count.
- Promotion 1 winners must retain their promotion-related Auto-Invest holdings until January 23, 2027, 08:00 (UTC), seven days after the promotion ends (T+7).
- Promotion 2 eligibility is ranked by the time all requirements are met. Users qualifying at the same time will be prioritized by their cumulative purchase amount, with higher amounts taking precedence. Each user may receive one voucher. Final eligibility will be verified after the promotion ends.
- The APR Boost Voucher applies to 7-day USDT fixed-term Earn products and adds 5 percentage points to the product’s base APR for 7 days, on an eligible principal of up to 10,000 USDT. The boost is annualized and does not represent a 5% return over seven days.
- Fee rebates are rounded down to whole USDT. Fees offset by GT, Point Cards or VIP subsidies are excluded. Rebates are based on eligible fees actually paid.
- All rewards will be distributed within 14 calendar days after the promotion ends. USDT rewards will be credited directly to winners’ spot accounts. Trading Fee Cashback Vouchers and APR Boost Vouchers can be viewed in the Rewards Center.
- Trading Fee Cashback Vouchers are valid for 28 days and APR Boost Vouchers for 7 days from issuance, after which they expire automatically.
- Gate will verify accounts, transactions, and fund flows during the campaign period. Prohibited activities include using multiple accounts to participate repeatedly, impersonating identities or submitting false verification materials, self-trading or wash trading, circular use of on-chain funds, organizing reward farming, repeated transfers of funds, and any other behavior that undermines the fairness of the campaign. Upon verification, Gate reserves the right to disqualify the users involved from receiving rewards.
- Users in the United Kingdom and other restricted jurisdictions cannot participate. Please refer to the User Agreement for applicable restrictions.
- Gate reserves the right of final interpretation of this promotion.
